fix(collector): tok/s lasts a whole turn, speed configs load again, a quiet session logs nothing and every provider closes (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.xae)

Speed samples come at transcript writes, which land seconds to minutes
apart in real work, so the 10 s sample window dropped long generations
and the draw ended the rate mid-turn. Each sample now says whether
Claude's turn was open after that write, read from the transcript (a
prompt opens it; an interrupt or a final assistant message closes it).
A pair is a rate only inside a turn, the current rate is the open turn's
latest measured interval, and it ends at the write that closes the turn.
With no clock in it, speed returns to the view's payload, so a config
whose cache policy reads speed.* loads as it did before. The observation
is its ring alone; its prev and cur restated the ring's last two samples.

- A source declares which triggers' clean refreshes write a line. The
  transcript leaves out its backstop period, so a held quiet session adds
  nothing to the log; its refreshes still count and a failed one writes.
- The providers' close runs every owner's close whatever an earlier one
  threw, and throws once naming each owner that failed.
- today fails on the session's own ingest only when the directory set does
  not already sum its transcript.
- The usage store's running tally counts refreshes, and is named so.
